traits.name: Society
traits.text: +6 Str +0, Dex +4, Con +3, Int +0, Wis +2, Cha +4 Items alchemical tools (used as "blessed items" to fool marks), backpack, cloak, hand crossbow (20 bolts), collection of fake relics, wooden religious symbol, studded leather armor, rapier.

traits.name: Deceiver's Surprise
traits.text: On the first round of combat, if the false priest rolls Deception or Performance for initiative, creatures that haven't acted yet are flat-footed to the false priest.

traits.name: Fickle Prophecy
traits.text: ⬻ (emotion, mental); The false priest convinces someone of their omnipotence by attempting a Deception check compared to the creature's Will DC. If successful, the target gains 1d8+4 (1d8+4) temporary Hit Points that last for 1 hour or until the false priest removes them by rebuking the target, whichever occurs first.

traits.name: Sneak Attack
traits.text: The false priest deals an extra 1d6 (1d6) precision damage to flat-footed creatures. This increases to 2d6 (2d6) against creatures flat-footed due to the false priest's Feint or deceiver's surprise.

traits.name: The Jig Is Up
traits.text: ⬲ Frequency once per hour Trigger The false priest critically fails a Deception or Performance check Effect The false priest Strides.

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ hand crossbow +12 (range increment 60 feet, reload 1); Damage 1d6+4 (1d6+4) piercing
